SELECT AVG(oxygen_count)
FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, SUM(a.element = 'o') AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond AS b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b.bond_type = '-'
  )
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)

WITH first_qualifying AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, MIN(r.date) AS first_date
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  GROUP BY q.driverId
),
youngest AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, fq.first_date
  FROM drivers AS d
  JOIN first_qualifying AS fq ON fq.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE d.dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)
)
SELECT r.year, y.forename, y.surname, r.name, r.date, r.time
FROM youngest AS y
JOIN races AS r ON r.date = y.first_date
WHERE r.raceId = (
  SELECT q.raceId
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS rr ON rr.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE q.driverId = y.driverId
  ORDER BY rr.date
  LIMIT 1
)

WITH annual AS (
  SELECT y.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total
  FROM yearmonth AS y
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
  GROUP BY y.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
minima AS (
  SELECT Segment, MIN(total) AS min_total
  FROM annual
  GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
  SELECT a.Segment, CAST(m.min_total AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS avg_min
  FROM annual AS a
  JOIN minima AS m ON m.Segment = a.Segment AND m.min_total = a.total
  GROUP BY a.Segment
)
SELECT
  (SELECT avg_min FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_min FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM'),
  (SELECT avg_min FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_min FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM'),
  (SELECT avg_min FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_min FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME')

SELECT SUM(res.points) AS score, c.name, c.nationality
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix' AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) AS gap
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
